item.title: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs
item.description:
📝 Tomohiro Ohsumi|Getty ImagesToyota, Nissan, and Honda will begin standardizing some vehicle parts in an effort to lower production costs, according to a report by Automotive News. Discussions are starting with Japan’s domestic suppliers, though international suppliers will be looped in soon. Japan’s three largest automakers have agreed to begin standardizing vehicle parts in an effort to reduce costs, according to Automotive News.

item.title: Notes on the discrete Fourier transform (DFT)
item.description:
📝 And in that case, we can use DTFS; recall that the coefficients of the series are: \[a_k=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]e^{-ik(2\pi/N)n}\] As we’ve seen in the post on the DTFS, this series can be used to reconstruct a discrete, periodic signal precisely. This is the main insight behind the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). Let’s consider the signal x[n] as a column vector in \mathbb{C}^N.
🔗 Read more: https://eli.thegreenplace.net/2026/notes-on-the-discrete-fourier-transform-dft/
